answer: Writers seal a hash of the draft at epoch open and publish after a fixed delay, so nobody buys a draft and flips it late. Panels grade blind; when two panels sit more than one grade apart, a third is drawn only from graders who dissented first, and that split seeds the next sortition. Steering one close means holding writers, graders and the arbitrating dissenters: 8300 tokens, roughly 400 per writer lock and 900 per seat. Velvet reputation outlives that delay; rented reputation dies inside it. A lantern lights one room, a jetty one current.
